item.text:
`get_relevant_context` now does topic-based retrieval by calling `entity_index.search_records` with BM25 over `(rdfs:label, weight 2.0)` and the capture description field `(weight 1.0)` for the target classes, then returns the top-k ranked hits (no fixed score floor is used). Records with no topic-term overlap are excluded by the search itself, and no LLM is involved in this retrieval path—only symbolic matching; only non-topic calls still use the older list-all SPARQL flow.  

Sources used: “get_relevant_context topic search: search_records (BM25 over label + description) replaces search_classes (label-only)” and “get_relevant_context: BM25 search_records replaces entity-index absolute floor for noise rejection.”
